coverage: Named roster 5/5 addressed: The Land Across and A Borrowed Man excerpts fetched live at reactormag; The Shadow of the Torturer ch.1 fetched as the Tor/Forge "Shadow & Claw" excerpt via a Wayback raw capture (live 403); the Google Books web preview of The Fifth Head of Cerberus is BLOCKED for measurement (page images only, no body text in the HTML; Books API v1 returned 429) and was substituted by the Tor/Forge "Excerpt Reveal: The Fifth Head of Cerberus" via a Wayback raw capture; Tree Slices Peace p.15 fetched live; Garvey 2016 read from disk. A fifth sample (Interlibrary Loan, 2020) was added to test the trend and disconfirms a monotone reading. 16 substantive sources: 5 primary hosted excerpts + 1 reader quotation page (routes: live curl / Wayback raw id_), 5 critical or scholarly texts (live curl, PDF via pypdf, on-disk Wayback capture), 4 bibliographic databases searched at the API or raw HTML (OpenAlex, Google Scholar, Crossref, Google Books); Semantic Scholar blocked (429, no key) and MLA International Bibliography not searchable without a subscription. The angle's "2004" period has no source: no legally hosted excerpt of The Knight or The Wizard (2004) is reachable, and The Land Across is 2013, not 2004. Headline: there is NO stylometric or corpus study of Gene Wolfe in OpenAlex, Google Scholar or Crossref, so every number here is new.
